source_coverage: 52 of 87 accepted quantitative records trace to S2; all 19 other S2 records are unquantified presence records. Additional 35 records are not certified by this compilation audit.
coordinate_caveat: S2 H76 says datums differ between papers. Rounded coordinate matching establishes lineage, not datum accuracy. All fitting coordinates remain unchanged.

cases.bounds_only: CSV 43: upper 10 cm; 52: lower 3 cm; 55: lower 7 cm. CSV 53 retains 6.7 cm pending conflicting source interpretations.
cases.s2_bounds: bounds_only, with CSV 53 lower 6.7 cm as explicitly reported in Takarada & Hoshizumi Table S2.
cases.primary_6p5: bounds_only, with CSV 53 fixed at the 6.5 cm endpoint of Danhara et al. Table 4's 6.5–7 cm range.
cases.primary_7: bounds_only, with CSV 53 fixed at the 7 cm endpoint of that range. Endpoints are sensitivities, not a probability distribution or rigorous bounds on total volume.
cases.omit_ambiguous: bounds_only, omitting CSV 4, 6, 14, 20: Machida Table 1 labels these afa?, pfl or afa, afa?, afa?. Classification sensitivity, not evidence that all four are flows.
cases.omit_row37: Original likelihood, omit KH76-2-7 (15 cm) to check the largest downward single-row PSIS influence. A valid influential record is not thereby rejected.
cases.omit_row49: Original likelihood, omit KH82-4-23 (1 cm) to check the largest upward single-row PSIS influence.
cases.offset_sd1: Original observations and priors except the SD of each source-relative centre displacement/scale coordinate: 1 instead of 3. Allows secondary maxima; no pseudo-observation or hard centre boundary.
cases.offset_sd6: Original observations and priors except displacement SD 6 instead of 3. Isolates this prior, unlike the older wide_geography case that also changed scale SD.

selection: No volume target, no model averaging over these cases, no automatic deletion of influential points. offset_sd1 uses the original four buffered geographic folds. The matched older offset_sd3 fit is the reference. offset_sd6 is a prior sensitivity, not a competing validated replacement.
